description.value: A coastal micro-brewery in the historic Townsite district of Powell River, on the shores of the Salish Sea along BC's Sunshine Coast. Known for Belgian-inspired craft beers, the tasting room pours a wide rotating selection including hazy pale ales, IPAs, stouts, and non-alcoholic options like craft soda and Nonny NA beer. The brewery is community-focused and also offers wine, cider, kombucha, and cocktails alongside its house brews.

address.value: 5824 Ash Avenue, Powell River, BC V8A 4R4
